WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: The catalogue of the five bundled examples, in one place for the two things that read it: the landing page's example chips (web/src/routes/+page.svelte, which links each to /report/gallery/<id>/ and puts `description` in the chip's title) and the build-time prebake (web/scripts/prebake-gallery.mjs, which runs every analysis on each and writes static/gallery/<id>.json). `description` is the one-line 'Description & Biological Domain' cell of the HyphAeon README's 'Included Benchmark Datasets' table (veg/HyphAeon@phase-2a README.md), verbatim; `paper.taxa`/`paper.codons` are that table's N and L before duplicate pruning and the taxon cap; `reference_runtime_sec` is PLAN.md section 1's measured `hyphaeon meme` wall time on a laptop CPU, the fallback when the engine's fixtures/manifest.json `e2e_wall_seconds` is absent. RHO is NEXUS with its tree embedded, so it has no tree file. Order is the landing page's chip order: the two small ones first, then the two whose trees carry no branch lengths (so they run tree-free on TN93 distances, D22), then the largest.
